include_directories(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
include_directories(${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/include)
add_subdirectory(include)
add_subdirectory(lib)
if(TRITON_BUILD_PYTHON_MODULE)
  add_triton_plugin(TritonPPU ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/triton_ppu.cc LINK_LIBS TritonPPUGPUToLLVM PPUGPUToLLVM TritonPPUGPUTransforms)
  target_link_libraries(TritonPPU PRIVATE Python3::Module pybind11::headers)
endif()

if(TRITON_BUILD_UT)
  add_executable(PPUMlaNopePrefetchTest test/prefetch_mla_nope.cpp)
  target_include_directories(PPUMlaNopePrefetchTest PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
  target_link_libraries(PPUMlaNopePrefetchTest PRIVATE LLVMAnalysis LLVMIRReader LLVMCore LLVMSupport)
  if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(PPUMlaNopePrefetchTest PRIVATE /UNDEBUG)
  else()
    target_compile_options(PPUMlaNopePrefetchTest PRIVATE -UNDEBUG)
  endif()
  add_test(NAME PPUMlaNopePrefetchTest COMMAND PPUMlaNopePrefetchTest)
  add_dependencies(TritonUnitTests PPUMlaNopePrefetchTest)
  add_executable(PPUMlaPvScalarizationTest test/scalarize_mla_pv.cpp)
  target_include_directories(PPUMlaPvScalarizationTest PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
  target_link_libraries(PPUMlaPvScalarizationTest PRIVATE LLVMAnalysis LLVMIRReader LLVMCore LLVMSupport)
  if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(PPUMlaPvScalarizationTest PRIVATE /UNDEBUG)
  else()
    target_compile_options(PPUMlaPvScalarizationTest PRIVATE -UNDEBUG)
  endif()
  add_test(NAME PPUMlaPvScalarizationTest COMMAND PPUMlaPvScalarizationTest)
  add_dependencies(TritonUnitTests PPUMlaPvScalarizationTest)
  add_executable(PPUMlaKvPipelineTest test/pipeline_mla_kv.cpp)
  target_include_directories(PPUMlaKvPipelineTest PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
  target_link_libraries(PPUMlaKvPipelineTest PRIVATE LLVMAnalysis LLVMIRReader LLVMCore LLVMSupport)
  if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(PPUMlaKvPipelineTest PRIVATE /UNDEBUG)
  else()
    target_compile_options(PPUMlaKvPipelineTest PRIVATE -UNDEBUG)
  endif()
  add_test(NAME PPUMlaKvPipelineTest COMMAND PPUMlaKvPipelineTest)
  add_dependencies(TritonUnitTests PPUMlaKvPipelineTest)
  add_executable(PPUMlaPvTailScheduleTest test/schedule_mla_pv_tail.cpp)
  target_include_directories(PPUMlaPvTailScheduleTest PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
  target_link_libraries(PPUMlaPvTailScheduleTest PRIVATE LLVMAnalysis LLVMIRReader LLVMCore LLVMSupport)
  if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(PPUMlaPvTailScheduleTest PRIVATE /UNDEBUG)
  else()
    target_compile_options(PPUMlaPvTailScheduleTest PRIVATE -UNDEBUG)
  endif()
  add_test(NAME PPUMlaPvTailScheduleTest COMMAND PPUMlaPvTailScheduleTest)
  add_dependencies(TritonUnitTests PPUMlaPvTailScheduleTest)
endif()
